template.scope: ground energy on the full unit sphere, all real amplitude vectors, axisymmetric polynomial potentials

dual.scope: minimum trace(C G) over all matrix Poisson envelopes on the full interval [-1,1]

certificate.objective: trace(C G); G dominates (1-t^2) v(t)v(t)^T for all t in [-1,1]
certificate.limitation: Optimality is within the fixed Poisson exponential ansatz, not the sharp spectral inequality.
